parameters.name: products
parameters.description: Finite set of products indexed by p

parameters.name: processes
parameters.description: Finite set of processes indexed by r

parameters.name: planning_periods
parameters.description: Finite set of planning periods indexed by t

parameters.name: processing_time
parameters.description: Processing time per unit of product p on process r

parameters.name: regular_capacity
parameters.description: Regular available hours on process r in period t

parameters.name: overtime_capacity
parameters.description: Maximum overtime hours on process r in period t

parameters.name: unit_profit
parameters.description: Standard profit per unit of product p in period t

parameters.name: overtime_profit_reduction
parameters.description: Profit reduction per unit of product p completed in overtime on the designated overtime-eligible process in period t

parameters.name: minimum_production
parameters.description: Minimum required production of product p in period t

parameters.name: minimum_total_profit
parameters.description: Minimum total realized profit over the planning horizon

parameters.name: exact_utilization_process
parameters.description: Designated process that must be used exactly at regular capacity in every period

parameters.name: overtime_eligible_process
parameters.description: Designated process on which overtime is allowed

parameters.name: utilization_targets
parameters.description: Utilization targets by process and period

variables.name: production_plan
variables.description: Total quantity of product p produced in period t

variables.name: overtime_allocation
variables.description: Quantity of product p whose work on the overtime-eligible process is performed in overtime in period t

variables.name: overtime_usage
variables.description: Overtime hours used on the overtime-eligible process in period t

variables.name: goal_deviations
variables.description: Optional deviation variables for goal-attainment or priority-goal formulations

constraints.name: nonnegative_overtime_allocation
constraints.description: Overtime allocation quantities must be nonnegative

constraints.name: integer_production_and_overtime
constraints.description: Production and overtime allocation quantities are integer-valued whenever whole units are required

constraints.name: minimum_production_requirement
constraints.description: Each product-period production quantity must meet the minimum production requirement

constraints.name: exact_capacity_use_designated_process
constraints.description: The designated exact-utilization process must use its regular capacity exactly in every period.

constraints.name: full_regular_capacity_overtime_process
constraints.description: The designated overtime-eligible process must use its regular capacity exactly in every period before overtime begins.

constraints.name: overtime_within_limit
constraints.description: Any overtime on the designated overtime-eligible process is limited by the available overtime capacity

constraints.name: profit_target
constraints.description: Total realized profit across all products and periods must be at least the minimum total profit target

constraints.name: production_decomposition
constraints.description: Total production is split into regular and overtime-produced units on the designated overtime-eligible process, ensuring the overtime allocation is accounted for linearly.

constraints.name: overtime_time_link
constraints.description: Overtime hours equal the processing-time-weighted overtime allocation on the designated overtime-eligible process in each period.

constraints.name: regular_capacity_exact_use
constraints.description: The designated exact-utilization process uses its regular capacity exactly in every period.

constraints.name: regular_capacity_full_use_overtime_process
constraints.description: The designated overtime-eligible process uses its regular capacity exactly in every period before any overtime is counted.

constraints.name: overtime_limit
constraints.description: Overtime usage on the designated overtime-eligible process cannot exceed the available overtime capacity.

constraints.name: utilization_targets_linked
constraints.description: If the utilization target matrix U is intended to be enforced, define the target coverage level as a linear equality to the corresponding process-period workload; this keeps the schema-consistent target data operational.

objectives.name: feasibility_of_production_plan
objectives.description: Find a weekly production and overtime plan that satisfies minimum production requirements, capacity rules, overtime limits, and profit target

objectives.name: minimize_goal_deviations
objectives.description: If a goal-attainment or priority-goal formulation is used, minimize the deviation variables associated with the stated targets

final_objective.description: The model is a feasibility-driven MILP; the previous generic deviation objective is removed because no explicit deviation equations are defined. The final objective is to find any feasible production and overtime plan satisfying all hard constraints.
